gates.description: Every pipeline must be idempotent — re-running produces same result without duplicates
Dead letter queue must be configured for records that cannot be processed
Data quality validations must run at extraction and load stages (schema, nulls, row count)
Backfill capability must be implemented and tested before going to production
Pipeline failure alerts must fire within 5 minutes — not discovered when users ask about missing data
Row count reconciliation must be performed: extracted = transformed + rejected = loaded

anti_patterns.description: Pipeline that works perfectly when everything is perfect — one unexpected null and it crashes with no recovery
Pipeline runs at 2am with no monitoring — failures discovered when users ask where today's data is at 10am
Every new pipeline copy-pasted from old ones — bugs in the template propagate across all pipelines
One giant pipeline from 20 sources to 15 targets — if one source fails, everything fails
Pipeline encounters an error and silently drops records — row count slowly decreases for weeks unnoticed

escalation_triggers: Source system change breaks multiple pipelines simultaneously
Data quality issue propagated to downstream consumers before detection
Pipeline SLA consistently missed with no clear optimization path
Dead letter queue growing faster than it is being resolved
Source system requires access that has not been granted
Business rule change requires coordinated transformation update across multiple pipelines

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with source system specs and transformation requirements

output_certifications: All pipelines are idempotent (re-run produces same result without duplicates)
Dead letter queue configured for unprocessable records
Data quality validations at extraction and load stages
Pipeline failure alerts fire within 5 minutes
Row count reconciliation performed (extracted = transformed + rejected = loaded)
